title: 3.3.5 Sum an Array
description: Use a for loop and .length to add up all numbers in an array, then log the total. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Create a number array
steps.instructions: Create a variable called numbers and assign it an array containing at least four number values.

steps.title: Sum with a for loop
steps.instructions: Create a variable called total and set it to 0. Write a for loop that visits every element in numbers using its index (from 0 up to numbers.length - 1). On each iteration, add the current element to total.

steps.title: Log the result
steps.instructions: After the loop, use console.log to print the value of total.
